method: Mixed: WebSearch (surfaced nothing) plus live Claude-in-Chrome page visits, which did surface one real visible audience comment.
evidence_policy: Only real, observed comment text is listed. Nothing here is inferred or extrapolated into a general 'pain point' or 'question' category unless the comment itself is phrased that way.

limitation_note: Only 1 real audience comment was captured this pass (from the single post-with-comments live-verified across 3 pages checked; Bangkok Asset and Mahanakornhome's live-verified posts had 0 visible comments). This is far short of a 'Top Customer Questions' / 'Top Customer Pain Points' list, and this single data point is a comparison remark, not a question or a stated pain point. Genuinely surfacing customer questions/pain points requires reading comment sections across many more posts — each post needs its own visit and the comments often need expanding ("ดูความคิดเห็นเพิ่มเติม") to see beyond the first 1-2 replies. This remains the weakest-covered deliverable of the six and should be prioritized in any follow-up session with more time for live browsing.
